about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Practical AI That Moves Your Business Forward
about.description: Auravine is an AI-first software development company in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We design and build AI voice agents, custom chatbots, computer vision systems, and business analytics platforms for local and international businesses that want real results, not experiments.

leadIn.label: WHAT WE DO
leadIn.thesis: We build intelligent products and the data foundations that keep them accurate and secure in daily operations.
leadIn.scope: From voice agents that never miss a call to face recognition attendance and demand forecasting, every solution is designed around a measurable business goal.
leadIn.integration: We design the AI, the data pipelines, the dashboards, and the integrations with your existing tools, so the whole system works together.

coreEngineering.label: Core Engineering
coreEngineering.title:
Proven stack.
Measurable results.
coreEngineering.p1: We build applied AI systems with Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, and LangChain, and expose models as reliable services through FastAPI and Flask.
coreEngineering.p2: We integrate AI into full-stack products with Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js, backed by PostgreSQL and Prisma ORM.
coreEngineering.p3: Every project uses version control, Docker containers, automated testing, and monitoring so it runs reliably in production.

agentic.title: AGENTIC AI SYSTEMS
agentic.desc: We are exploring AI agents that can complete multi-step tasks, such as qualifying leads, reconciling records, and routing support requests, with human approval where it matters.

web3.title: BANGLA & MULTILINGUAL AI
web3.desc: Our research improves speech recognition and language understanding for Bangla, English, and code-mixed conversations, so AI products serve customers in the language they actually speak.

profile.narrative: We start with the business problem, then choose the simplest technology that solves it. Our teams combine AI expertise, solid software engineering, and clear communication so clients always know what is being built and why.
profile.narrative2: Whether you run a clinic, a retail chain, a factory, or a growing startup, we deliver solutions that are secure, scalable, and designed for the people who use them every day.

experiencesList.desc: We map your processes, review your data and systems, and deliver a written plan with scope, timeline, and expected business impact before development starts.
Agile delivery with a working demo every two weeks. We connect AI products to your CRM, POS, accounting, messaging, and telephony tools.
User acceptance testing, staff training, and a controlled rollout so your team is confident from day one.
We monitor performance, retrain models as your data changes, apply security updates, and share monthly reports on outcomes.
Not sure where to start with AI? We assess your readiness, prioritize use cases by value and effort, and build a practical roadmap.

hero.title: LET'S TALK
hero.subtitle: Have a business problem AI can solve? Let's explore it together.

faqData.a: We build AI voice agents for customer calls, custom chatbots for websites and messaging apps, computer vision systems such as face recognition attendance and quality inspection, business analytics dashboards, and custom web and mobile software.

faqData.q: Do you work with international clients?
faqData.a: Yes. We are based in Dhaka and work with businesses across South Asia, the Middle East, Europe, and North America. Our projects are remote-friendly, with regular video demos and clear written updates.

faqData.q: Can your AI voice agent and chatbot handle Bangla?
faqData.a: Yes. Our voice and chat products support Bangla, English, and code-mixed conversations. We test every deployment with real examples from your customers before launch.

faqData.q: How do you keep our data secure?
faqData.a: You choose where your data lives, including your own cloud account or on-premise hardware. Access control, encryption, audit logs, and backups are standard in every project.
Book a free consultation using the form above. We will review your goals, suggest a practical first step, and send a written proposal with scope, timeline, and pricing.
